sources.title: Trade Everything Demo browser DOM observation
supports: Browser DOM lists BTC,ETH,HYPE,SOL,BCH; BCH is below the retained screenshot viewport.
DOM describes the next NVDA pre-market session cap375x; the screenshot itself shows current overnightMax250x.

No screenshot hash is assigned to off-viewport DOM text; no mainnet activity or admission inferred.
